generated_slips.estimated_payout_note: Payouts follow the certified graders: PrizePicks base x model factor (compressed), Underdog table x pick multipliers, Sleeper product of multipliers. The app's displayed payout at entry is authoritative.
generated_slips.strategy_notes: Estimated EV: +0% per unit staked, vs a 76.98% breakeven hit rate needed per leg. 4 legs share a game - same-game legs are correlated (EV assumes independence). Replay slate - these games are already played; this is a what-if build.

base_power.note: all-standard; 5 and 6 verified 2026-09-21 (WNBA slips run, 3 player sets each, unadjusted)

compression.formula: payout = product if product <= knee else knee * (product/knee)^exponent

flex_alt_tiers.why: PrizePicks partial tiers are nearly flat in the factor product (3-Flex one miss ~1.0x up to fp 3.4, 5-Flex one miss ~2.0x up to fp 6.8, two misses 0.4x); the certified grader scaled them by the full factor product and overpaid them 2-5x (2026-10-09, quotes run 38020184454 + probe 38021265189 + 2026-09 WNBA mining).
flex_alt_tiers.meaning: Flex payout for a slip WITH goblins/demons, by size n and number of misses: [factor_product, payout] points; payout = linear interpolation in ln(factor_product) between points, clamped to the end points. Each point is the LOWER ENVELOPE (min payout PrizePicks quoted at that factor product or above) - conservative by construction.
sources: nba_market.pp_quote NBA+WNBA status 200, legs priced in pp_mined_leg(_wnba)

sleeper.flex: round-robin over the (n-1)-pick sub-combinations, stake split evenly; all hit = average of the n products; one miss = product of the other n-1 / n; two misses (Sleeper pays them only at 5+ picks) UNVERIFIED -> 0 (conservative)
sleeper.power: PRODUCT of the picks' displayed payout multipliers; all must hit
sleeper.voids: push / DNP voids the pick, entry graded as if never included; < 2 live picks = refund (1.0); a Flex reduced to 2 live picks pays as a 2-pick Max
sleeper.source: owner MLB entries 2026-09-10: 19 placed slips + app screenshots (classification_config board_payout_conversion_rules), MULTIPLIER_TABLES_MASTER.md section 5 (3/3 Flex 2.775 predicted vs 2.78 real; 2/3 0.884-0.963 predicted, 0.92 real); outside sources agree (BettingUSA 'cumulative', OddsAssist 2-pick 2.84x / 3.12x); Sleeper help centre for Flex shape, voids and limits
sleeper.function: nba_market.sleeper_slip_payout(mults float8[], results text[] hit|miss|void, mode power|flex, haircut numeric default this row)
sleeper.replicated: 2026-10-09 (owner: be sure it is replicated to NBA)
sleeper.ledger_root: per-leg effective price in nba_score.price_shop_ledger = m x (1 - slip_haircut)^(1/2) (the 2-pick Max carries the most haircut per leg -> the conservative per-leg price)
sleeper.note_2026_10_10: MLB slips showed a 2-8% cut below the product; NBA entries pay the plain product (2-pick, Flex) or more (3-pick Max). slip_haircut 0.08 -> 0.0; the 3-pick bonus is recorded, not priced (conservative) until confirmed.
sleeper.per_leg_from_odds: payout_multiplier = 1 + (decimal - 1) x 0.95 (verified exact; only needed when deriving from sportsbook odds - the NBA board carries Sleeper's own multipliers)
